price_status: synthetic fallback only; live market 310 prices are applied separately
price_method: Synthetic prices only support the standalone evidence projection; recommend_vuelta_live.py uses live Scorito prices.

model_method.stage_points: PCS specialty/form + field-strength-adjusted and exact-course-matched 2026/2025/2024 results + validated stage similarity, mapped through empirical TdF/Giro Scorito rank-points curves with finish uncertainty
model_method.classification_jersey: separate calibrated proxy using GC, points, KOM/climb and youth signals; not enrolled-stage points
model_method.field_strength: PCS startlist-quality score, field size and race ranking; race class is an explicit fallback
model_method.course_matching: exact PCS profile, distance, vertical metres, ProfileScore, final-km gradient and finish type
model_method.quality_ratings: continuous 0.0-10.0 ratings in 0.1 steps from effective specialty capabilities plus field/course-adjusted evidence
model_method.capabilities: immutable raw PCS/recent-result signals plus explicit, provenance-bearing effective overrides; absolute eligibility precedes relative ranking
model_method.age_trajectory: modest continuous modifier; never a name or age exclusion
model_method.tactics: provisional-team profile hierarchy only; no declarations available
model_method.availability: no named exclusion; objective unavailable riders require cited evidence
model_method.validation: 42-stage leave-one-out PCS model: macro Spearman 0.5403, top-10 hit rate 0.4333
